# Unicode normalization gold

`NormalizationTest-16.0.0.txt` is the complete unmodified official Unicode 16.0.0
NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD conformance corpus, dated 2024-04-30. Tests use its published NFC
invariants for all five columns. Independent raw-origin expectations live in
`tests/parsing/test_normalization.py`; the official text gold does not label raw
contributors or prove protected worker execution.

Source: https://www.unicode.org/Public/16.0.0/ucd/NormalizationTest.txt
